issues.description: The UML in the problem statement (and the template Farm.java) declares singFarmSongVerse as a private method, but the solution implementation declares it as protected. This visibility difference is a structural inconsistency and may confuse students about the intended access level of the helper method (private according to the specification) versus what the reference solution provides.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent: either change the solution's singFarmSongVerse to private to match the UML/template, or update the UML/problem statement and template to declare the method as protected and document why protected is required (e.g., for testing or subclass access).
